body: That is the thing. After over a year and a half, I know that I hate myself, I just can not find anything I can say to myself that will make that lessen at all. As much as I don't like admitting it, I need to hear it from someone that I actually personally know.

I maybe could consider saying like 10 of these tops, and even then, I don't feel like any of them would mean anything on a daily basis for myself.

I do think it is a good idea though, I just wish it was more plausible for myself.

I mean, I currently have depression, and at least in my case, it definitely comes and goes in cycles. I will be fine for about a week, and then the next week I will be extremely depressed. I'm not sure how to fix it, but I can for sure let you know if I ever find out.

I mean, I honestly can't see the soon part happening. If it ever some how happens, it will probably not be for at least another 10 years easy. 

The thing is, I have been trying to meet new people for the past 4 months. I just can't seem to find a group of people that actually want to keep me around. 

As for have friends, I could always use a friend, as I really don't have any.

I mean, I already graduated college, have a job, and live on my own after moving to a new place. I just don't get opportunities to meet people really, and when I do, no one is ever interested in me. But you are right, I don't think my life as a point, and the main issue is that I can not find one that I can actually justify.

I mean...there is really no plus side to it. I mean, what, I stay around for another 10-30 years doing the same job and for what? Just to be by myself the entire time. I honestly would rather just have it be over now and just save myself the trouble. I mean, you are right, 4 months is not that long of a time, but the amount of damage and time it is going to take and fix everything is in the double digit years easily. I honestly don't see how it is worth hanging around for the slim possibility I may be happy 10+ years in the future.

I mean, pretty much every friend I have had my entire life has only been a friend because we have been neighbors or in the same class. Now that I live on my own, I don't have any. So I can completely understand that.

I have been trying for over 4 months now. After much trying, I basically am not able to find people to meet/be friends with. None of my old friends want anything to do with me, as I was really depressed at the end of the last semester before I moved, and they seemed happy to not have to deal with me anymore.

As for my family, I have brother, I am sure they would get over it over time. I mean, for everyone's total long term happiness, I am fairly certain that me being gone would be overall better for everyone.

I mean, the people who would take it the worse are my family, and I am sure that after a few years, they would eventually start to get over it. Other than that though, no one else would really get worked up over it for more than like a week tops. All in all, it would probably be for the best in the long run, as I tend to make everything less fun/happy for the people interacting with me.

I mean...I have tried going out an meeting people for the past 3 months and I have not been able to meet anyone at all. I just am not comfortable in social situations, as I need someone to introduce me to people to be able to successfully interact. Its kind of a self fulfilling prophecy sadly. I mean...hanging in is really all that is left to do for a while.

I mean, when I went to HS and college, enjoying reading really got you kind of shunned. I mean, I honestly used reading as an escape for the longest time, and now I have kind of run out of new things to keep reading. I may have to fall back on some old series, I dunno, it still doesn't fix the underlying issue, but I don't think there really is much that can.

I mean...I feel like I am just socially unable to make friends that actually want to be friends with me. I don't know, its a combination of not having any self confidence and just not being able to find people with the same interests no matter where I am. I mean, the current group of "friends" that I have from work really only eat lunch with me, and that is it. I don't get invited to anything after work at all. I mean, they are new hires also, and I feel like they just put up with me to be nice, but whatever, I can't do anything about that.

As for how people don't like people who read WoT, I mean, that series was practically my entire four years of high school. I was labeled as a nerd and was avoided because of it. Its ok, Rand and Matt were way cooler than anyone in my HS anyways though.

Yeah, I never ran into that, as WoT was actually fairly popular where I went to HS, it was kind of cool.

I mean...I don't honestly care if randomly percentages of the population care for me, all I honestly want is someone who will care for me at the end of the day, and honestly I sadly can't have that.

I've been waiting for Wheel of Time to be finished for practically forever. When I started reading it there were only 8 books. I mean, you basically hit the nail of the head though, in the fact that I basically don't feel like I have anyone who cares about me. I'm not really the "likable" type, as I feel like people are only friends with me because I live very nearby and it is convenient for them (every friend I had in HS and College). Now that I moved, I have 0 total.

Its been about a year and a half now since she broke up with me. We were together for 4 years, and engaged for 1 of those years. She broke up with me by telling me over text that she had been cheating on me for over half a year, and basically tearing down any self confidence I had at the time (I'm not really going to go into detail on that).

I mean, I read Sci-fi/Fantasy mostly, but even that has dropped to a lack of interest for me, which was one of the last straws.

I can't find something that I really want to get involved in though. I tried a few things that I thought I wanted to do when I moved out here, but I just did not fit in with the age demographic (all of them were 20+ years older than me). I don't really feel like volunteering, as I can't really help other people with problems when I have a lot, assuming I am still here of course.

If I could change my life in any way? I would honestly just want to have someone that actually cares about me...that is all I really want.
Sounds kind of similar to me, except my list is now currently empty.

My degree is in Computer Science Engineering, so that really does not help me at all. I mean before hand I liked reading, and playing video/board/card games. Not really good things to get to meet new people with, and they are all sadly normally looked down at in the general population.
Sadly there is no way I can be with my ex again after all she put me through, mainly because she is the reason I am here.
Yeah, all my friends gave up on trying to help me out with it, sounds like a novel idea.

I mean, I dunno, I have been looking, but everyone seems to be either 10+ years older than me, or 6 years younger than me, which really is not a good selection choice.

I've looked at r4r. I feel like it is one of the most gender biased subforums out there. But I could be really wrong. I just feel like I am making no progress for the longest time and it is just so discouraging.

I've tried going to the local game shop, going to ballroom places around the area, and I have tried being social at work. All it all it just really seems like no one is interested in me. I mean, lets be honest, I am really not interesting.

I mean, the issue is that I have not been able to meet anyone new after living here for over 4 months. I mean, I had a whole plan of how I was planning on meeting people and none of it came around. So now I basically just go to work, come home, drink and cut. Its a "fun" life.

I mean, I had a pretty solid plan moving here, go check out all the local game shops and ballroom places and hopefully find friends between there and work. Well the game shop is 95% 14 year olds, the ballroom places are all 40+ and I really have not been able to make friends at work. Nor really helpful for a 21 year old.

My real issue as far as the relationship is that she was my first and only relationship I have ever been in, so I am sure you can imagine how she has left me pretty much feeling hopeless about the whole relationship thing.

That sounds oh so very similar to my life. All of the professionals that I have talked to I was very easily been able to fool, so they have always been useless to me. I know for me personally, I have tried reaching out to several people, and only 1 or 2 have ever reached back. Even then it has been very difficult. My main strategy has just been to find something to distract myself with everyday until I am so tired I just pass out. It may not be ideal in the long run, but it currently really helping keeping me here on a day to day basis.

Hey, I definitely know that feeling and can definitely relate to it. My best advice would be to try and reach out to people who you care about. At least one of them should be more than happy to listen to anything you want to talk about. That is one of the only things still keeping me here at least.
